instruction: You're standing in the middle of the stairs of a house, and if you look back you will see the stairs go up and head to the top floor of the house and stand in the middle of the hallway. You're going to have an opening, a doorway to your left that heads towards the patio area or a balcony, with two planters hanging in the balcony, and in front of you you're going to see the hallway has some artwork hanging on the walls, and there's an opening to your right that heads into another room, and then at the back of the hallway, at the end of the hallway you're going to see there's an entry to another room, walk towards that room across the hallway and enter the room. This room, now that you're standing here, seems to be a bathroom, there's a bathroom sink right in front of you. Walk towards the white bathroom sink with the mirror and the flowers and look to the left, there you'll see there's an open door heading to the bedroom. Walk into the bedroom, once you are in the bedroom you're going to see there's a desk, sorry a night lamp to your right side and there's a shelf with some books on it to your left, a white shelf, and in front of you you will see doors that lead to the balcony and a bed to your right, a white bed to your right. Keep walking past the bed and towards the window doors to the balcony, and to your right you're going to see a rest chair with a reading table, walk towards the chair and look right, and to your right you're going to see there's an opening to the closet, a door to the closet, walk towards that closet and you're done.
